mechanism_narrative: The observed consistent week-over-week increase in RETAIL_REC mobility over the last four weeks indicates a sustained recovery trend, which will continue to drive retail and recreation activity higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The significant recent surge in PARKS mobility (from -51.4% to -37.3% in the last week) suggests improving weather or increased outdoor activity, which will spill over into other leisure activities and boost RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not show an increase in the next two weeks following a >10 point jump in PARKS.

mechanism_narrative: The combined trend of decreasing RESIDENTIAL time and increasing WORKPLACES mobility indicates a shift away from home-centric activities towards out-of-home engagement, which will directly translate to higher RETAIL_REC as people spend more time in public spaces over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC declines while WORKPLACES continues to rise and RESIDENTIAL continues to fall.

mechanism_narrative: The steady increase in GROCERY_PHARM mobility, reflecting essential out-of-home trips, indicates a baseline level of public comfort and movement that, under a 'reopening' regime, will encourage more discretionary RETAIL_REC activity over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM continues to rise but RETAIL_REC does not improve in a reopening environment.

mechanism_narrative: The consistent decline in RESIDENTIAL mobility, indicating fewer people staying at home, is a direct behavioral signal that more individuals are venturing out, which will lead to a sustained increase in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL mobility continues to decrease but RETAIL_REC does not show an upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: A continued increase in TRANSIT station activity, if it surpasses a 2-point week-on-week rise, will signal a significant return to public transportation use, which facilitates access to retail and recreation areas, boosting RETAIL_REC over the next one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT increases by more than 2 points week-on-week
failure_condition: If TRANSIT increases by more than 2 points week-on-week, but RETAIL_REC does not increase in the subsequent week.

mechanism_narrative: The strong recent increase in PARKS mobility, combined with the existing upward trend in RETAIL_REC, suggests a seasonal uplift in outdoor and leisure activities that will reinforce and accelerate the recovery of retail and recreation over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If PARKS mobility continues to rise but RETAIL_REC growth stalls or reverses within the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The slow but steady increase in WORKPLACES mobility, even if minor, indicates a gradual return to office work. In a 'reopening' regime, this sustained presence of people in commercial areas will provide a consistent, albeit slow, uplift to RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES mobility continues its upward trend but RETAIL_REC shows a decline over the next four weeks.
